audience: support and sales teams that work customer conversations in Superchat across WhatsApp, email and other channels

useCases.title: Find open conversations and who is assigned to them
useCases.text: List the conversations of the workspace and open one to read its status and assignment. List the team members to match an assignee with a name.

useCases.title: Read the message history of one customer thread
useCases.text: Open a conversation and list its messages in the order the API returns them. Read one message by its id when you need a single message.

useCases.title: Review a contact and all of their conversations
useCases.text: List the contacts of the workspace and open one to read its custom attributes. List the conversations of that contact.

useCases.title: Check which channels and inboxes are connected
useCases.text: List the connected channels, such as WhatsApp or email, and open one by its id. List the inboxes of the workspace.

useCases.title: Look up message templates and conversation labels
useCases.text: List the message templates of the workspace. List the labels that tag conversations, to see which tags exist.
